output.answer_markdown: IQVIA described 2024 as another year of strong operating results, with income from operations up over 11 percent and operating cash flow up over 26 percent from 2023 [1]. On segments, Technology & Analytics Solutions saw revenue and profit growth improve in the second half as clients increased spending, while Research & Development Solutions also produced revenue and segment profit growth in 2024 but faced challenges in the latter half that management expects to partly persist into 2025 and considers short-term [2]. Remaining performance obligations were a record of about $33.5 billion at December 31, 2024 [3]. On liquidity, IQVIA said it continues to maintain strong liquidity, with cash and cash equivalents of $1,702 million and $825 million drawn under its $2,000 million revolving credit facility, and it was in compliance with its financial covenants in all material respects [4].
